facts.text: I am planning a photography trip to Yellowstone.
I need help finding the best spots to capture scenic views and wildlife.
I plan to bring my Nikon D500.
I have a 70-200mm f/2.8 lens that I have been really happy with.
I am thinking about selling my old Canon Powershot G7 X Mark II.
I listed my Canon Powershot G7 X Mark II on Craigslist for $400.
I have had a few inquiries for my Craigslist listing.
I am thinking of buying a remote shutter release for my camera.
I am thinking of buying a flash for my camera.
I organized my photography gear on March 10th.
I bought a new camera bag, the Lowepro ProTactic 450 AW, on March 10th.
The Lowepro ProTactic 450 AW can fit all my lenses, cameras, and accessories.
